run_GoogleTest_unit_tests: run the unit test suite by calling Main() to parse flags and execute tests
get_test_executable_path: get the absolute path of a test binary given its name and optional build directory
set_environment_variable: set or unset an environment variable to a given value using SetEnvVar
run_subprocess_command: run a subprocess command with optional working directory and stderr capture via Subprocess class
get_exit_status: extract the exit code from os.system result using GetExitStatus for cross-platform compatibility
